concerns_addressed: Exact reorder formula max(0, average daily demand × lead_time_days − available stock) with fixture 60/30=2, 2×5=10, reorder 7 and warning.
30-day rolling demand includes only positive quantities from non-excluded orders within the window.
Negative stock clamped to zero; null/negative lead time produces insufficient-data with no false reorder.
Sufficient stock or zero demand returns explicit no-action with reorder 0.
Stock-planning section published via stage and read via ActiveDataSnapshotReader with snapshot_version/window metadata; no live recomputation.
Route is admin-only with existing 401/403 contract and no data leak.

strengths: Deterministic demand/formula isolation in service and authorization at controller boundary.
Consistent ActiveDataSnapshotReader usage with other BI controllers.
Exactly the four packet files touched; no product ordering behavior changed.

issues.description: reorderQuantity applies ceil() rounding; spec states exact formula without rounding. Integer-safe and never produces false negatives.
produce() iterates all products without is_active filter; inactive products still receive planning payloads.
